instruction.en-GB: Wash the vegetables. An adult cuts the carrot and pepper on a stable board; children tear broccoli into florets.

heatOrKnifeCue.en-GB: Adult-only sharp knife and heat steps are identified above.

instruction.en-GB: Wash the vegetables. An adult cuts the carrot and pepper on a stable board; children tear broccoli into florets.

adultAssist.en-GB: Children wash vegetables, tear broccoli and mix the cool sauce. Adults chop, boil, drain and stir-fry.

safety.en-GB: An adult handles boiling water, hot oil, the wok and all knife work. Keep children away from the hob and hot pan. Cook noodles per packet, drain facing away from steam and serve hot. Check allergen labels and prevent cross-contact.

nutrition.basis: Approximate per-serving estimate based on weighed recipe amounts and generic USDA FoodData Central ingredient data. Product composition and drained weights vary; not laboratory analysis.
nutrition.method: Scale generic FoodData Central nutrient data per 100 g by measured ingredient weights, sum and divide by 4; rounded values. Brand-specific sodium and fats vary.

cross_contact.en-GB: Check ingredient packaging for allergens and cross-contact. The mozzarella contains milk; balsamic vinegar may contain sulphites. Noodles contain wheat/gluten, soy sauce contains soy and wheat, and sesame oil contains sesame.
cross_contact.pt-BR: Confira as embalagens para alergênicos e contato cruzado. A muçarela contém leite; o vinagre balsâmico pode conter sulfitos. O macarrão contém trigo/glúten, o molho de soja contém soja e trigo, e o óleo de gergelim contém gergelim.
